{{Quote|Unless you sensitive artists have got any special requests, you're deployed with Aquila and Manka&mdash;two men riding with each CSF assault ship. Okay?|ARC-Captain Alpha-26, to Omega Squad|<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Manka Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Separatist assault]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="O66" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Manka Squad, together with fellow [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[unit]]s [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Aquila Squad|Aquila]], were tasked to assist the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in maintaining domestic security.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manka Squad first appeared in the [[2008]] novel [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], the fourth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] by author [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="O66" />
